jobs.title: AI Strategist - US
jobs.description: Factify Website Platform The Problem Who It's For Book a Demo Book a Demo Careers / AI Strategist - US United States · Sales · Senior · Full-time AI Strategist - US Apply Description About us We are building the Governed Truth Infrastructure that makes agentic AI safe for highly regulated industries like banking and insurance. Powered by our proprietary "Seal, Enforce, Prove" architecture and backed by a growing patent portfolio, our platform is already live in production with enterprise partners driving real ARR. We designed this infrastructure specifically for the builders on the front lines: developers, AI strategists, and Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs). With FDEs now the fastest-growing role in tech - up over 700% year-over-year - these teams need a secure, reliable foundation to govern AI agents performing high-stakes work. That’s exactly what we provide: a platform they can trust. We're well-funded ($73M raised), the team is strong, and there's real momentum in the market. This isn't a bet on "maybe it'll happen" - it's already happening. ﻿ The Role The Applied AI Strategist helps customers turn complex business needs into practical AI solutions. This role combines business understanding, applied AI fluency, product thinking, and strong execution. You will work closely with customers and internal teams to understand problems, define solutions, guide implementation, and ensure the resulting systems deliver measurable value. You will bring structure to ambiguous challenges, make thoughtful trade-offs, and help move AI initiatives from concept to reliable production use. What You'll do Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, requirements, constraints, and goals. Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities for applying AI. Translate ambiguous business needs into clear solution plans, requirements, and success criteria. Design and validate solution concepts through prototypes, demonstrations, and structured evaluations. Define prompt, context, workflow, and evaluation approaches for AI-powered solutions. Coordinate stakeholders and maintain alignment throughout implementation. Guide trade-offs across speed, quality, reliability, scalability, governance, and customer impact. Identify and resolve risks or blockers that could affect successful delivery. Measure solution performance, adoption, and business value. Turn recurring customer needs and implementation lessons into reusable capabilities and best practices. Requirements 5+ years in product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, technical program management, or another customer-facing technical role. Experience taking complex software, data, machine-learning, or AI initiatives from concept through production and adoption. Strong applied AI fluency, including familiarity with LLMs, agents, retrieval, tool use, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, and human-in-the-loop workflows. A first-principles approach to turning ambiguous problems into practical, applicable solutions. Strong product and systems judgment. The ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences. High ownership, attention to detail, and follow-through. Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities. Excellent written and spoken English. ﻿Strong Advantages Experience using Python, SQL, APIs, or modern AI tools to prototype and validate ideas. Experience with workflow automation and orchestration tools (e.g., UiPath, n8n, Make, Power Automate, or Zapier) Experience in financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry. Familiarity with policy, compliance, risk, or other rules-driven workflows. Experience working with enterprise requirements such as security, privacy, data governance, and system integrations. A degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or another relevant technical or quantitative field, or equivalent hands-on experience. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: Factify Website Platform The Problem Who It's For Book a Demo Book a Demo Careers / Senior Product Designer Tel Aviv, Israel · Product Management · Senior · Full-time Senior Product Designer Apply Description About Factify ﻿ We are building the Governed Truth Infrastructure that makes agentic AI safe for highly regulated industries like banking and insurance. Powered by our proprietary "Seal, Enforce, Prove" architecture and backed by a growing patent portfolio, our platform is already live in production with enterprise partners driving real ARR. We designed this infrastructure specifically for the builders on the front lines: developers, AI strategists, and Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs). With FDEs now the fastest-growing role in tech - up over 700% year-over-year - these teams need a secure, reliable foundation to govern AI agents performing high-stakes work. That’s exactly what we provide: a platform they can trust. We're well-funded ($73M raised), the team is strong, and there's real momentum in the market. This isn't a bet on "maybe it'll happen" - it's already happening. ﻿ The role This is a crucial role on a small, senior team. You own your work end to end: UX & UI in one person. No one handing you specs, no layers between you and the product or engineering. You'll work directly with our VP of Product on a product that doesn't yet have a design playbook. That last part is the real job. We're designing a category that doesn't exist. Surfaces where both people and AI agents consume the same information. Interfaces for multiple types of personas - technical teams who live in APIs and business owners who care about business output. Views that shift by role and permission. Nobody has good patterns for this. You'll invent them. What you'll do Own product design end to end, from core experiences to the details nobody else notices. Take an abstract, ambiguous problem and turn it into something people trust on sight. Design for two users at once: the human making a decision and the agent doing the work. Make governance, provenance, and permissions feel like clarity, not compliance overhead. Shape the brand and make Factify feel like nothing else in the category. Requirements A full-stack product designer. Strong UX, strong UI, real brand instinct. Not great at one and thin on the rest. AI-first mindset. You feel at home working hands-on with AI tools and operating agents on your behalf. You will not be able to keep up with the team without that. Product thinking under ambiguity. You can take a vague, hard problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and defend the cut. Craft. You care about the pixel, the microinteraction, the moment something clicks. Delight isn't decoration to you. It's how trust gets built. Comfort with technical and infrastructure products. jobs.description: Factify Website Platform The Problem Who It's For Book a Demo Book a Demo Careers / Senior Full-Stack Engineer Tel Aviv, Israel · R&D · Senior · Full-time Senior Full-Stack Engineer Apply Description About Factify ﻿ We are building the Governed Truth Infrastructure that makes agentic AI safe for highly regulated industries like banking and insurance. Powered by our proprietary "Seal, Enforce, Prove" architecture and backed by a growing patent portfolio, our platform is already live in production with enterprise partners driving real ARR. We designed this infrastructure specifically for the builders on the front lines: developers, AI strategists, and Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs). With FDEs now the fastest-growing role in tech - up over 700% year-over-year - these teams need a secure, reliable foundation to govern AI agents performing high-stakes work. That’s exactly what we provide: a platform they can trust. We're well-funded ($73M raised), the team is strong, and there's real momentum in the market. This isn't a bet on "maybe it'll happen" - it's already happening. ﻿The role We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build reliable, high-impact product experiences from browser to backend. You will own meaningful product areas, turn ambiguous customer problems into pragmatic technical solutions, and help set a high bar for quality, speed, and engineering judgment. ﻿What you’ll do Design, build, test, deploy, and operate end-to-end product capabilities. Build polished frontend experiences with React and TypeScript. Develop scalable backend services and APIs with Node.js and TypeScript. Partner closely with Product and Design to shape solutions before implementation. Make sound architecture decisions across application boundaries, APIs, data models, security, performance, and observability. Use AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to improve development speed and quality, while rigorously validating their output. Build AI-enabled or agentic product capabilities where they create clear customer value. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, pairing, documentation, and mentorship. Requirements 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience delivering senior-level work, including substantial full-stack ownership. Strong production experience with React and TypeScript across frontend and backend development. Strong experience with Node.js or another production backend stack, including API design and operation. Deep understanding of web architecture, testing, security, performance, and production operations. A record of independently delivering customer-facing products, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and following work through production. Hands-on experience shipping AI-enabled or agentic capabilities to production with a framework such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or an equivalent, including disciplined validation of outputs. Nice to have Experience with Go. Experience designing microservices, event-driven systems, or cloud-native applications. Experience with LLM integrations, retrieval, evaluation, or AI workflow observability. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and modern observability tooling.
